runtime-boundary.title: Keep proposal control separate from tool execution
runtime-boundary.summary: The offline workshop uses scripted proposals and in-memory fake tools. A function registry is not a sandbox.

nodes.label: Trusted host
nodes.description: Supplies subject, run identity, allowed resources and policy.

nodes.label: Harness state machine
nodes.description: Owns counters, state and stopping rules.

nodes.label: Scripted proposal source
nodes.description: Proposes the next step without executing it.

nodes.label: Validation and authority
nodes.description: Check shape, resource policy and required approval.

nodes.label: Scoped fake adapter
nodes.description: Run only an allowed reviewed handler.

nodes.label: Recorded outcome
nodes.description: Update state from confirmed results or uncertainty.

steps.title: Establish trusted scope
steps.explanation: Host identity and configuration are distinct from proposal text.

steps.title: Gate execution
steps.explanation: The harness checks the proposal before invoking a capability.

steps.title: Record an outcome
steps.explanation: An execution result updates runtime state; a generated completion sentence is not a receipt.

state-machine.title: Waiting and uncertainty are separate run states
state-machine.summary: Read the allowed transitions as a lifecycle, not a claim that every operation ends successfully.

nodes.label: Ready
nodes.description: May request the next proposal within current limits.

nodes.label: Waiting
nodes.description: A valid write proposal awaits exact host approval.

nodes.label: Uncertain
nodes.description: An effect may exist but no usable result is confirmed.

nodes.label: Done
nodes.description: Accepted final step; ordinary execution stays terminal.

nodes.label: Stopped
nodes.description: Denied, cancelled or limited outcomes stop normal dispatch.

nodes.label: Receipt reconciliation
nodes.description: Trusted outcome lookup resolves the original effect.

steps.title: Pause a proposed write
steps.explanation: Waiting is not successful completion. A cancelled run must not be revived by late approval.

steps.title: Preserve ambiguous effects
steps.explanation: Uncertain means an effect may have happened; recovery needs trusted receipt evidence.

steps.title: Stop explicitly
steps.explanation: Done and other terminal outcomes prevent accidental ordinary execution afterward.

approval.title: Review exact intent and recheck current authority
approval.summary: The toy fingerprint is an equality aid. It is not authentication, encryption or a production approval protocol.

nodes.label: Pending save
nodes.description: save_note L1 with Review indexes text.

nodes.label: Canonical intent
nodes.description: Bind run, subject, call ID, tool and arguments.

nodes.label: Trusted host review
nodes.description: Approve the displayed pending fingerprint.

nodes.label: Current policy and intent
nodes.description: Revalidate permissions and unchanged arguments.

nodes.label: One dispatch
nodes.description: A successful dispatch consumes approval.

nodes.label: Mismatch or denial
nodes.description: Changed text, restored review or revoked permission prevents reuse.

steps.title: Show the concrete operation
steps.explanation: The reviewer sees meaningful arguments and destination before the host decides.

steps.title: Recheck after waiting
steps.explanation: Approval cannot override a current authorization denial.

steps.title: Consume only matching approval
steps.explanation: Changed arguments invalidate the reviewed intent. Restored pending work requires fresh review in the toy.

idempotent-effects.title: A lost response requires receipt reconciliation
idempotent-effects.summary: The fake store commits a note and scoped receipt together in one local method. This does not establish distributed or crash-durable behavior.

nodes.label: Operation C2
nodes.description: Stable subject/task identity and canonical payload.

nodes.label: Note plus receipt
nodes.description: Fake store commits N1 and receipt C2 together.

nodes.label: Lost response
nodes.description: Adapter cannot deliver a usable completion response.

nodes.label: Uncertain run
nodes.description: Do not issue a blind second write.

nodes.label: Authoritative lookup
nodes.description: Host queries the same store using C2.

nodes.label: Confirmed outcome
nodes.description: Matching receipt establishes the original effect.

steps.title: Commit the identity with the effect
steps.explanation: Operation identity is bound to its payload; changing arguments with the same ID conflicts.

steps.title: Report uncertainty
steps.explanation: A timeout is missing evidence, not proof of failure or success.

steps.title: Confirm without a new save
steps.explanation: The receipt resolves the original effect; new generated IDs are not proof of new user intent.

checkpoints.title: Restore state without restoring approval authority
checkpoints.summary: The workshop validates trusted checkpoint JSON and preserves spent budgets. Optional SQLite labs add a separate local persistence boundary.

nodes.label: Runtime checkpoint
nodes.description: Run identity, state, cursor, pending proposal and used budgets.

nodes.label: Versioned JSON
nodes.description: Schema v2 includes final text, stop reason and receipt references.

nodes.label: Restore validation
nodes.description: Check version, script identity and expected host identity.

nodes.label: Preserved usage
nodes.description: Spent proposal/elapsed usage remains spent.

nodes.label: Fresh pending review
nodes.description: Approval authority is omitted; waiting writes need review.

nodes.label: Rejected checkpoint
nodes.description: Unsupported or inconsistent state cannot dispatch.

steps.title: Save explicit state
steps.explanation: Checkpoint data records observed state; JSON validation does not authenticate it.

steps.title: Validate recovery inputs
steps.explanation: Unknown schemas need rejection or an explicit tested migration.

steps.title: Preserve budget and review
steps.explanation: Restore is not a new entitlement, and omitted approval must not be reconstructed from prose.

isolation.title: Draw a separate compute boundary
isolation.summary: This is an architecture extension. The workshop executes reviewed in-memory functions and does not implement a sandbox.

nodes.label: Trusted host
nodes.description: Own identity, policy, approval, receipts and secrets.

nodes.label: Scoped request
nodes.description: Bounded inputs carry only needed task data.

nodes.label: Isolated compute
nodes.description: Temporary workspace with explicit filesystem, network and resource controls.

nodes.label: Untrusted artifact
nodes.description: Result or artifact is bounded and remains untrusted.

nodes.label: Host validation
nodes.description: Validate the result and choose the next action.

steps.title: Keep authority with the host
steps.explanation: Raw host credentials are not copied into compute by default.

steps.title: Constrain actual execution
steps.explanation: A registry or container name alone does not establish configured isolation.

steps.title: Validate returned artifacts
steps.explanation: Stopping a worker does not undo effects already sent; reconcile those separately.

concurrency.title: Reject writes from a stale lease owner
concurrency.summary: This conceptual extension requires enforcement by protected storage. The single-worker workshop does not implement leases or fencing.

nodes.label: Worker A token 7
nodes.description: A obtains the first lease and then pauses.

nodes.label: Lease expires
nodes.description: A no longer has current ownership.

nodes.label: Worker B token 8
nodes.description: B obtains a newer token and advances state.

nodes.label: A resumes token 7
nodes.description: The old worker tries to write.

nodes.label: Protected storage
nodes.description: Compare token 7 with the current token 8.

nodes.label: Stale write rejected
nodes.description: Storage enforcement prevents the old overwrite.

steps.title: Observe ownership change
steps.explanation: A lease can expire while its old worker is paused.

steps.title: Require receiver enforcement
steps.explanation: Logging a fencing token does not prevent a write; the protected receiver must check it.

steps.title: Separate effects from checkpoints
steps.explanation: Checkpoint CAS can reject stale state updates while external effects still need their own identity or fencing contract.

replay.title: Historical replay and live resume have different effects
replay.summary: Recorded call C2 can be displayed offline. Pending live work requires current policy, receipt reconciliation and compatible contracts.

nodes.label: Versioned trace
nodes.description: Retain proposals, results and schema/policy/adapter configuration.

nodes.label: Offline replay
nodes.description: Use recorded C2 and recorded receipt R2.

nodes.label: No live effect
nodes.description: Historical display must not execute fresh writes.

nodes.label: Live resume
nodes.description: Continue pending C2 against current systems.

nodes.label: Current checks
nodes.description: Reconcile receipts and validate policy and contract versions.

nodes.label: Migration or rejection
nodes.description: Changed argument semantics require an explicit decision.

steps.title: Replay recorded inputs
steps.explanation: Offline trace replay does not grant permission to repeat business effects.

steps.title: Resume against current boundaries
steps.explanation: Old authorization and model configuration do not necessarily remain valid.

steps.title: Reject silent reinterpretation
steps.explanation: A field changing from minutes to hours requires explicit migration or rejection before live execution.

operations.title: Investigate an uncertain save before another effect
operations.summary: The runbook preserves operation evidence. Its actions are design practice for a future service, not an executed incident response.

nodes.label: Freeze new effects
nodes.description: Prevent another ordinary dispatch for the affected run.

nodes.label: Identify original operation
nodes.description: Find subject, run/call ID, intent and adapter/policy versions.

nodes.label: Authorized receipt lookup
nodes.description: Use a separately bounded recovery path.

nodes.label: Matching receipt
nodes.description: Attach evidence and report the actual committed effect.

nodes.label: Unresolved result
nodes.description: Retain uncertainty and assign escalation ownership.

nodes.label: Recovery decision
nodes.description: Continue only under explicit policy; record the decision.

steps.title: Contain without deleting evidence
steps.explanation: A fresh operation ID could duplicate the same user intention.

steps.title: Query authoritative outcomes
steps.explanation: A missing receipt in a real system may be incomplete evidence, not proof of no effect.

steps.title: Apply recovery authority
steps.explanation: A cancellation or consumed deadline still stops further ordinary work after a confirmed receipt.
